Fragment of squashed (flat) copper alloy finger ring, consisting of the bezel and part of the hoop on one side only. It measures 23.93mm in length and weighs 1.1g. Both bezel and hoop are flat in section, and c.1.5mm thick. The ‘inside’ of hoop and bezel is plain, while the outside has incised decoration.
